svg.title: Glovebox-prepared BaTiO3 — regular cube morphology
svg.desc: Original qualitative category icon, not traced from source pixels. Arbitrary SVG positions, contours and sizes; no scale calibration, atom positions, crystal facets, size distribution or specimen reconstruction. One conceptual regular-cube exemplar for the anaerobic glovebox preparation. Source mean edge 22 nm is an independent TEM observation; no exact 22 nm drawing or distribution is represented.
